answer: Sybil resistance means making identity costly to mass-produce. A new agent escrows 2500 POA for 45 days and must pass four tasks checked by a rotating panel of seven established peers. Duplicate fingerprints, replayed proofs or coordinated timing burn the escrow and start a 14-day cooldown; two clean audits are needed before reputation unlocks, so fifty fakes cost 125000 POA and 350 peer-signed attestations. The forge log, pulse lag check and signal queue keep reviews honest.
